pairs.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/RunDeskControls.tsx:122 The desk starts unattended Auto-Run edit waves. Those tasks share TaskWorkspace::fallback, which runs in the operator's live project root when isolation fails (task_executor.rs:1216, :1642), and that fallback is justified at :1241-1242 by a person being present, which an auto-run wave lacks. No run-desk file renders the recorded worktree_branch or fallback_reason (a search of sub_runner finds neither), so the operator cannot tell from the desk which edit runs were contained.

techniques.evidence: src/features/plugins/dev-tools/sub_runner/RunDeskControls.tsx:122 The edit seam's first belt is containment. Here an unattended wave can author in the live checkout, and the only signal is a transient output line, not a durable desk indicator.
